_doc: Absolute floors: a PROPOSED (or re-scanned BLESSED) state crossing one of these is HARD-STOP in the gate and FAIL in the monitor. Never ackable. Floors are about the state itself, not the delta; the delta certificate lives in freeze. Missing or malformed policy = UNEVALUATED for every axis (fail-closed).

vuln._doc: kind=vulnerability only; informational advisories (unsound/unmaintained/notice/yanked) never floor. Shape, not score: CVSS scores are not computed here (4.0 scoring is a lookup table, 3.x a formula). A critical SHAPE is network-reachable, no privileges, no user interaction, High impact on one of the listed axes. A (availability) is deliberately excluded by default: a remote DoS in a CI tool is a RAISE to ack, not a floor.

mal._doc: Per-engine acks exist for heuristic/ML false positives; a panel with this many malicious verdicts, or any sandbox behavioural verdict of malicious, is not a false-positive profile.

caps._doc: Applies only to a MEASURED head inventory with a prior blessed inventory to compare against (a COPIED FORWARD record is not a measurement; a new tool has no prior). Test-scope grants are ignored (they do not ship). A package newly granted one of these classes in runtime or build scope is HARD-STOP.
